prose: Tonight's episode will be a solo presentation on my research into Katasterisms and Euhemerisms, in a nutshell, the interplay between mythology, history, and the Astro-Logos. Pulling together varied sources, I will be exploring the nature of scriptural miracle stories, syncretizing the source of ancient mythology in the stars, and the strange ways that linguistic links and punning priests have cunningly crafted our ancient history.
